workflows.name: n8n Autonomous AI Agent (Tools + Memory + LLM Model)
Inbound Webhook → AI Agent Analysis → Email Dispatch
workflows.description: Receives customer inquiries or alerts, analyzes sentiment and extracts key points using Gemini AI, then sends an email notification.

config.samplePayload:
{
  "customer": "Alex Mercer",
  "email": "alex.mercer@enterprise.io",
  "company": "Apex Dynamics",
  "inquiry": "We urgently need enterprise automation for 50,000 daily events with custom webhook triggers and AI classification.",
  "priority": "High"
}

config.systemPrompt: You are an elite sales engineering AI. Analyze the customer inquiry. Return a clean JSON object with summary, estimatedContractTier (Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3), urgencyScore (1-100), and recommendedNextSteps array.

config.subject: 🔥 HIGH PRIORITY LEAD: {{$node["Gemini AI Lead Analyst"].json.estimatedContractTier}} from {{$json.company}}
config.bodyHtml:
Urgent Lead Notification

Customer: {{$json.customer}}

Summary: {{$node["Gemini AI Lead Analyst"].json.summary}}

Urgency Score: {{$node["Gemini AI Lead Analyst"].json.urgencyScore}}/100

config.messageText: Standard lead queued from {{$json.company}}: {{$node["Gemini AI Lead Analyst"].json.summary}}
